name: Novus - C2000
description: Novus C2000, a perfect blend of economy and exceptional performance. With its spacious and comfortable ride and efficient power system, every journey is stable and reliable.

influence.description: The second-generation Jetta (A2) was a practical compact sedan built on the Golf platform. It was known for its reliability, roomy trunk and comfortable ride, and became one of the best-selling European cars in the US.

name: Novus - B100
description: The new Novus B100, featuring lightweight construction and low center of gravity, delivers stable yet responsive driving feedback.

influence.description: The N-Box is a tall, boxy kei car with a 660 cc engine and a surprisingly spacious cabin with rear sliding doors. It was Japan's best-selling new car for several years running, loved for its practicality in tight city streets.

name: TerraX - G3
description: G3, with its unmatched robust look, paired with the most advanced four-wheel drive system and luxurious interior, ensures your confidence and poise in any setting, whether it's for business or leisure.

influence.description: The fourth-generation Jimny combines a retro, boxy look with serious off-road hardware: a ladder frame, rigid axles and part-time 4WD with low range. It was so popular that buyers faced waiting lists stretching for months and even years.

name: Novus - M1000
description: Novus M1000 features a compact body design with exceptional agile handling, letting you navigate through city traffic with ease.

influence.description: One of the last examples of the classic Mini, produced almost unchanged since 1959. Its transverse engine and front-wheel drive gave it a tiny footprint and go-kart handling, and the Cooper versions became legends in rallying and city driving alike.

name: Novus - ST79
description: ST79, featuring a simple and practical mechanical structure, and a retro appearance paired with a mechanical manual transmission full of character. Pure driving pleasure begins here.

influence.description: The AE86 Sprinter Trueno is a light, rear-wheel-drive coupe with pop-up headlights and a high-revving 1.6-litre 4A-GE twin-cam engine. Its balance and simplicity made it a cult icon of drifting and Japanese street racing culture.

name: Regalia - Griffin
description: Griffin, a masterpiece of craftsmanship and technology from Regalia, is equipped with the latest driver assistance system and intelligent infotainment system. The sleek body and signature pop-up headlights perfectly reflect Regalia's pursuit of excellence in detail.

influence.description: The "Flachbau" (slant-nose) was a rare version of the 930 Turbo with a flattened front and pop-up headlights, inspired by Porsche's 935 race cars. Built in limited numbers, it is one of the most distinctive and collectible 911s of the 1980s.

name: Novus - Enforcer
description: Enforcer. Bold body lines and raw horsepower combine in a tough, reliable design built to help you dominate the road.

influence.description: The seventh-generation Charger is a full-size rear-wheel-drive sedan with muscle-car styling and engines up to a 707 hp supercharged Hellcat V8. It is also widely known as a police pursuit vehicle across the US.

name: Regalia - Pursuit V8
description: Pursuit V8, with its precisely tuned all-wheel drive system and deep rumbling sound upon startup, you'll experience the pure appeal of mechanical engineering.

influence.description: The GT-R50 by Italdesign was built to celebrate 50 years of both the GT-R and Italdesign. Limited to 50 units, it features a hand-built twin-turbo V6 with about 720 PS, all-wheel drive and a dramatic bespoke body.

The 930 was Porsche's first turbocharged production 911, recognisable by its wide fenders and "whale tail" spoiler. Paired with a four-speed gearbox, it was famous for its savage turbo lag and its reputation as a car that demanded respect.

name: Porsche - Taycan Turbo GT
description: Taycan Turbo GT with Weissach Package. Powered by Future. Born to conquer.

influence.description: The Taycan Turbo GT with Weissach Package is the most extreme version of Porsche's electric sports sedan, delivering over 1,000 PS on overboost. It shed weight by dropping the rear seats and set a lap record for production EVs at the Nürburgring.

name: Regalia - LaVelox
description: LaVelox, equipped with a hybrid power system, combining cutting-edge engines and the latest technological materials, redefining what it means to be a supercar.

influence.description: LaFerrari was Ferrari's first hybrid hypercar, combining a 6.3-litre V12 with an electric motor for a total of about 963 PS. Limited to 499 units, it formed the famous "hypercar trinity" alongside the McLaren P1 and Porsche 918.

name: Regalia - Pendragon
description: Pendragon. Regalia's latest masterpiece for future exploration, forging new supercar legends with cutting-edge technology.

influence.description: The Senna is McLaren's most track-focused road car, named after Ayrton Senna. Its 800 PS twin-turbo V8, ultra-light carbon body and aggressive active aerodynamics put lap times ahead of comfort and looks.

name: Porsche - 918 Spyder
description: Porsche 918 Spyder - sculpted for the future, engineered to perform. Built for those who never settle for ordinary.

influence.description: The 918 Spyder is a plug-in hybrid hypercar with a V8 and two electric motors producing 887 PS and all-wheel drive. Built in 918 units, it was the first road car to lap the Nürburgring Nordschleife in under seven minutes.
